page.overview:
Who is Annie Crawford's Hallucinations?

Annie Crawford's Hallucinations are set of various characters FBI Agent Annie Crawford sees in the FBI Call Center.

Crawford sees these characters while speaking to Lisa over the phone. The two original figures appear to be illusions of FBI Agent(left) and FBI Agent 2(right). The latter's existence is left ambiguous however. It is likely that these hallucinations Crawford sees is linked to her bipolar medication Lunatrix, which she consumes excessively.

Category:FBI Agents Category:One-time characters
